_notes: Locally added -- upstream pinmame-nvram-maps has no map for this revision.
Built from a 4-player game driven through the cabinet's own streamer.
current_player and current_ball are adjacent in CPU RAM at 0x00035A4C and 0x00035A4D, player low
and ball high. Scores are 4 bytes on 4-byte centres from 0x021109E4.
Nothing here is shared with mtl_180h, the next revision up, and that is the point worth carrying:
its scores are 8 bytes apart from 0x02110A24 where these are 4 apart from 0x021109E4, and its
records are 36 bytes with the checksum at +32 where these are 32 bytes with it at +28. Same
title, one revision apart, and every layout detail differs.
Fifteen records from 0x021036D8 on a 32-byte stride, bounded by where the checksum stops
validating. The first five are the high score ladder. The remaining ten are the per-song mode
nine of ten positions if Blackened is moved from second place to last. That is suggestive of a
champions, all ten named. Their factory defaults collide -- four records hold 25,000,000 and two
hold 15,000,000 -- so the DMD alone could only pin down the four with unique values.
What resolves the rest is a second table at 0x02102510 on a 0x18 stride holding the same ten
values in the same order: the operator-settable champion thresholds. Setting five of them to
distinct figures (Battery 22M, Enter Sandman 24M, Fade To Black 27M, For Whom 26M, Blackened 16M)
named each slot in that table, and the five positions left alone still match the champion records
value for value, which is what shows the two tables share an order rather than assuming it.
That also settles the mtl_180h comparison: Blackened really is last here where it is second there,
the shift that was visible in the defaults but not provable from them.
Only mtl_170h is claimed.
game_over, tilted and credits come from a 1,088-frame recording of live memory spanning an
0x00035A7E is the status bitfield most SAM games keep at ball+0x31, with a ball-start value the
others do not use: 1 in attract, 41 (0x29) for the first samples of each ball, 19 (0x13) in play,
21 (0x15) for the eight samples between the tilt and the end of the tilted ball, during which
player 1's score sat frozen at 341,810. The mask 0x12 that decodes game_over on trn_174h and its
siblings shares no bit with 41 and would read every ball's start as game over; mask 0x38 covers
all three in-play values and excludes attract, and is correct in every one of the 1,088 frames.
tilted is bit 0x04, which 41 does not carry, so that reading survives here.
credits at 0x0211100C, the eleventh SAM game at that address.
2026-11: Master Volume and the A.1 (64) and A.2 (136) adjustments added from the ROM image
(README, 'Adjustments from the ROM').
Confirmed on a cabinet 2026-11-13 (ALP4K, vpx-metallicapremium switched to mtl_170h; two
players, tilt on P1 ball 1): 1,268,690 / 1,212,840, the records and the status byte (01, 29 ball
served, 13 play, 15 tilted) matched the DMD.
